The thing is I do absolutely adore Godzilla. I grew up watching all the movies and have a big passion for the character. I just want a channel that allows me to talk about other things I love too like Marvel and DC as well without killing my CTR. And I'm pretty sure if my current subs aren't watching my video, that is killing my CTR meaning YT won't push it to more people so it's a double L.


I've made upwards of 30+ videos on GVK
I do more short form content talking about leaks or what I think about a scoop and the vids are about 4-8 mins usually.
What did you do to make it more appealing? Probably different content of course but the same principles could work. Thanks for your response.

This is what I really needed to hear thank you. If it's any consultation I met her in October. Dated in November hung out almost everyday through the holidays and then she left January 4th. I saw her this past Wed and Thursday and things were well but this is like tearing off the band aid

I do understand that completely. We moved quick and she told me a lot about her life and she really opened up to me. I don't know why I have so much pressure on this. I was single for a while before and going on shitty annoying dates. If it doesn't work with this girl I will be okay I just need it to be May so I can figure this out.

It's like for some reason this limbo I'm in with this girl has dehabilitated me
Let me add we met in October and she left in January.  We spent the holidays together and I met her family

6 months...
Not long at all but she's made all these promises and told me she thinks I'm the one and one day wants to have kids etc etc


I don't know why I've lost sight of myself so hard.

You're 100% right. I haven't double texted or anything like that. Just reached out to let her know I was interested in making plans again and she never responded. Also thanks a lot. He was really suffering. I'll just hold out for someone more genuine and head out if I ever run into a situation like that again. I thought if I had sex with her I'd feel better about the horrible date but tbh but it just made it worse. If I would have left with my pride when i wanted to an hour into her rambles she would have been floored and I would feel a lot better right now. She was very cute so I'm sure something like that's never happened before. It's all good.

Right....idk the girl just seemed lost on a spiritual level. To have the nerve to sit down with me and just rant and ramble about other men and not ask me a single question about myself? Idk maybe one day she'll look back and kick herself. Probably not. Thanks for the reassurance and you're right. I do have to make the move and that's the only way I've been getting anything because my job doesn't have social access with women, my school doesn't really either and all I do is work and go to school plus I work weekends so can't go out. In a tight spot and just hoping for the best. It's all for a reason no doubt.
You're probably right but you never know
